entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A cheerful Rakdos emissary and razorwitch on Ravnica, later revived as a blood witch.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon leader of the Cult of Rakdos, who sent Hekara as an observer.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Hekara's best friend, for whom Hekara was a role model.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A being few can see and remember; Hekara could before her revival.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker rallying forces against Nicol Bolas; Hekara calls him her mate.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who allied against Bolas and later betrayed the group.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed the Obzedat and led a group to win guild support.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Azorius ally possessed by Bolas who killed Hekara.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon opposed by the guilds.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: Rakdos's representative who lost a fight to Hekara.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who became the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked Bolas with Rakdos's help.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war against Nicol Bolas on Ravnica.

events.summary: Rakdos sent Hekara as an observer to Ral Zarek, who was rallying forces against Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Hekara was sent as an observer by Rakdos to Ral Zarek

events.summary: Hekara was killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia while saving Ral's life.
events.quote: she was killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia while saving her "mate" Ral's life

events.summary: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch.
events.quote: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch

events.summary: Exava objected to Hekara's help and lost to her in a fight.
events.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

events.summary: Rakdos replaced Exava with Hekara as his official representative after the war.
events.quote: After the War, Rakdos replaced Exava with Hekara as his official representative.

relations.quote: Hekara was the best friend of, and a role model for, Araithia Shokta
